context: Ren confides to Saito about a recent breakup; honest emotional talk.
purpose: Young man processing relationship loss with elder mentor.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Quiet opening, voice slightly tight. Careful breath before speaking. Soft, direct — not seeking comfort yet, just stating the fact. Vulnerable underneath the control.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Gentle pause at the opening. Warm, measured tone — no rush. The kind of acknowledgment that lets him know he doesn't need to explain. Slight lean-in with the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I still can't make sense of it.
lines.style: Hesitant start. Quiet, searching for words. The admission of confusion more important than the words themselves. Slight trailing-off — unfinished thought.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Simple, steady statement. Not a question. The certainty of someone who has heard this before. Warm but not prescriptive — just naming what's true.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Quiet realization, almost to himself. Small exhale before speaking. Wistful but not self-pitying — the tone of someone discovering something true. Slight weight on the word.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Gentle, quiet certainty. Not dismissing his pain but placing it in something larger. Spoken with the weight of having seen many people through this. Warm, almost tender.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、聞いてくれて。
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. Small, steady voice. Not effusive — the kind of thanks that means something. Slight bow in the voice at the end.
